message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause is the vendored `slugify`, which strips every character outside `a-z0-9`, so "è" is removed instead of becoming "e". You said not to edit `vendor/`, so I left it alone. I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js`: `postSlug` now normalizes the title and removes the accent marks before passing it to `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs will still drop accented letters. I didn't touch it because you only asked about blog posts. It would take the same one-line change if you want it.
